name: Omacube
author: Tiedeyez
description: Your desktop as a 3x3 puzzle cube. An animated background of an endless isometric stack of cubes that turn their layers and tumble with real physics: only free cubes move, sliding out of the pile so nothing ever passes through anything. Here and there a giant solved cube built from the same cubes rises out of the pile and spells OMARCHY in a sticker mosaic, every cube a legal state; every two minutes the word scrambles and re-forms. Colours come from your current Omarchy theme. Workspace switches slide the stack sideways with your windows. Renders at 6K by default; pixel art is one setting away. The optional Omacube theme adds the classic colours and cube-face tiling. One GPU fragment shader; reads only the theme colours and its own mosaic data, no processes or network.
